findings.title: Cleanup ticker changed from 10m to 1m without justification
findings.body: pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go line 77 changes the background cleanup ticker from time.Minute*10 to time.Minute*1. This makes all cleanup jobs (snapshots, dashboard versions, images, annotations, invites, short URLs, query history) run 10x more often. The PR description only discusses annotation deadlocks and never mentions frequency. This increases DB/CPU load and risks overlapping with the 9-minute cleanup timeout. It looks like a debug leftover and should be reverted.

findings.title: Routine cleanup logs at Error level with full ID lists
findings.body: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go logs normal cleanup progress with r.log.Error at lines 534, 537, 554, 557, 576 and 579, including the full ids slice (up to AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize, e.g. 32767 IDs) and cond on every batch even on success. The err field logged on the fetch path is nil at that point. This will flood error logs, trigger false error alerts/monitors, and pay large serialization cost per batch. These leftover debug logs should be removed or demoted to Debug without dumping all IDs.
